What’s free forever?: Tracking — sleep, feeds, diapers, growth — is free with no time limit. The plan adds Ask, weekly guidance and insights.
How does the 14-day trial work without a: Download the app and everything is unlocked for 14 days. No card, no auto-charge. When the trial ends you simply keep free tracking — nothing to cancel.
Is this medical advice?: No. FirstWeeks gives educational information with cited pediatric sources. It doesn’t diagnose and doesn’t replace your pediatrician — and it will tell you plainly when something needs one.
What happens to my data?: Your baby’s name is removed before any AI request. No ads, no data selling. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and you can export or delete everything anytime.
Can my partner use it too?: Yes — one plan covers both parents, and logs sync between devices in seconds.
When is Android coming?: We’re iOS-first for now. Android is planned — leave your email on the Support page and you’ll be the first to know.
How do I cancel?: App Store subscriptions: one tap in your Apple ID settings. Web plans: one click in your account. No emails, no calls, no retention flows.
Can I export data for my pediatrician?: Yes — a clean PDF summary of sleep, feeds, diapers and growth for any date range, ready to hand over at a checkup.
